comparison: Evaluate cached old additive crossfit predictions on exactly the same surviving rows. Full and Nov-Dec aggregate calibration, logloss, mean sale receipt, joint +/-10 price changes. No causal label.
pagination_flag: Raw device-date-exact-price group occupies positions on both sides of any 50-row boundary. A flag for potential unstable coverage, not proof individual row is wrong. Preserve all eligible rows; report separate calibration.
gap_audit: After dropping copied Nov19, enumerate consecutive appearances within listing using fresh-calendar index. Compare temporary observation gaps with preceding boundary flag and whether prices match at both ends. Future reappearance is a selection condition; descriptive only.
limits: A one-day calendar interval is not proof of exact request times or complete inventory. Unobserved rival offers and private seller information remain. No new finite performance guarantee follows from this correction.
